title: Oil Infused Spanish Apricot Pilaf
description: A savory and light Spanish dish featuring dried apricots, this pilaf is perfect for a weeknight dinner, it is low in fat and can be served in an earthenware bowl.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large earthenware bowl over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chopped dried apricots and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the uncooked white rice and stir to combine with the onion and apricot mixture.
Add the smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the chicken broth and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the bowl with a lid, and simmer for 20 minutes.
Turn off the heat and let the pilaf rest for 5 minutes.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and serve hot.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
